rootCauses.requiredInput: Approve an optional sanitized avatar/media URL in the safe /me projection and provide the approved account avatar asset mapping, or approve initials as the canonical identity treatment.
rootCauses.recommendedOption: Approve the optional sanitized avatar field with an initials fallback; do not hard-code identity artwork.

resolution.decision: Initials are the approved canonical identity treatment when the safe account projection has no approved avatar URL. Identity artwork is not hard-coded and an absent avatar is no longer a parity blocker.

rootCauses.requiredInput: Approve the exact provider, request, viewing, notification, preference, property, project, advertising, commission and contact fields that are safe and authoritative for each affected response.
rootCauses.recommendedOption: Approve a minimal field matrix by domain and expose only fields backed by stored authoritative data; retire Figma-only sample values.

resolution.decision: Only stored, authoritative fields already exposed by each safe domain projection are canonical. Figma-only sample aggregates and presentation fields are retired; unavailable data stays explicitly unavailable.

rootCauses.requiredInput: Provide approved property/provider/project media assets and sanitized public URL fields, including the intended fallback behavior.
rootCauses.recommendedOption: Use the existing media storage/public URL boundary and approve optional URLs with the current truthful missing-media fallback.

resolution.decision: Existing sanitized public media URL boundaries and truthful missing-media fallbacks are canonical. No private storage key or invented asset may be rendered.

rootCauses.owner: Product, Security and account/provider API owners
rootCauses.requiredInput: Approve state transitions and security policy for viewing cancellation, richer account settings actions, password change and account deletion before enabling the controls.
rootCauses.recommendedOption: Keep controls fail-closed until versioned mutations, authorization, audit, session revocation and rollback rules are approved together.

resolution.decision: Implemented seeker viewing cancellation and account password change remain enabled. Irreversible or unapproved provider/account actions stay fail-closed and disabled as the approved canonical state until separately commissioned with authorization, audit, rollback and session-revocation rules.

rootCauses.requiredInput: Provide current email-only canonical profile/settings frames or formally retire the historical phone fields.
rootCauses.recommendedOption: Publish email-only replacement frames and retain the current contract prohibition on inferred phone identity.

resolution.decision: Current email-only account/profile compositions supersede historical phone-era fields. Phone identity must not be inferred or restored from legacy design samples.

rootCauses.requiredInput: Approve the owner-authored ADM-54 source and intended geometry, or recover an exact canonical owning frame.
rootCauses.recommendedOption: Approve or replace the source before any bounded geometry repair or strict closure claim.

resolution.decision: The owner-authored ADM-54 HTML/PNG pair is approved as the current owning source. Historical Figma recovery is not claimed; reviewed Arabic and English runtime baselines are required for closure.

completionRule: All six root causes are resolved by the Project Owner decision. Current safe contract-backed variants are canonical, ADM-54 uses its approved owner-authored owning source, and no historical Figma recovery is claimed.
